pattern: SELECT .* FROM ([a-z]+) JOIN ([a-z]+) ON (\w+\.\w+) = (\w+\.\w+) GROUP BY \w+ ORDER BY SUM\((\w+\)) DESC LIMIT 1
correction: Replace the ORDER BY clause with ORDER BY count(*) and ensure that the GROUP BY clause includes all columns not used in the aggregate function

metadata.description: This rule corrects SQL queries where the ORDER BY clause orders results by an incorrect aggregation function, such as SUM() instead of count(*)
